2855|774f3757.name: Snang
2855|774f3757.text: I will teach you what I can.

3296|3e1a976e.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|3e1a976e.text: Godan's Runeworks is where you'll go.  Look for it on the west end of The Drag, right next to the Valley of Wisdom.

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

5880|f341dff7.name: Un'Thuwa
5880|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1884-accept.name: Un'Thuwa
1884-accept.text:
The warlock Zalazane of the Echo Isles has disrupted the normal flow of magic in Durotar.  He does this through tainted fetishes, ju-ju heaps, which he has placed among his huts on the main Echo Isle.

These heaps corrupt our wildlife and give power to the warlocks and infernal creatures that lurk in the land's dark corners.

You must destroy the ju-ju heaps, $N, before the flow of magic is forever altered.
1884-accept.title: Ju-Ju Heaps

1884-complete.name: Un'Thuwa
1884-complete.text:
I sense that Zalazane's ju-ju heaps were destroyed, and with time, and luck, the flow of magic in Durotar will return to normal.

A great deed you have done for your people, $N.  And you have shown your worth to us, the mages of the Horde.
1884-complete.title: Ju-Ju Heaps

754-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-complete.text:
News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.

You have done a great thing for the land, $N. And you have done a great thing for the $R people.
754-complete.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

756-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-accept.text:
To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
756-accept.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
756-complete.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

758-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-accept.text:
The totem is ready, $N. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
758-accept.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

761-complete.name: Harken Windtotem
761-complete.text: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, $N.  In doing this, you prove that you are a $c of merit.  It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
761-complete.title: Swoop Hunting

761-progress.name: Harken Windtotem
761-progress.text: Have you found the swoops, $N.  Do you have their quills?
761-progress.title: Swoop Hunting

772-complete.name: Seer Wiserunner
772-complete.text: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
772-complete.title: Rite of Vision

773-accept.name: Seer Wiserunner
773-accept.text:
To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, $N.
773-accept.title: Rite of Wisdom

786-complete.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-complete.text:
The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.

And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.

You have served your people well, $c.
786-complete.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

840-accept.name: Takrin Pathseeker
840-accept.text:
Hmm, you look pretty strong.

Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.

Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
840-accept.title: Conscript of the Horde

96102-complete.name: Snang
96102-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96102-complete.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-complete.name: Kor'geld
97242-complete.text:
This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.

I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242-complete.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with them in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97934-complete.name: Chaw Stronghide
97934-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97934-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
